## Pseudo-claim 1 — filter (discardHeavy)

**[PSEUDO-CLAIM — illustrative only; not a legal opinion or admission that any code practices this. `file:line` = orientation pointer, not a finding.]**

A method of filtering a catalog of widgets, comprising: receiving a catalog of widgets each having a name and a weight; discarding each widget whose weight exceeds a threshold weight read from a configuration file; sorting the remaining widgets by the length of the name; and emitting a report of the ten longest names together with a timestamp of the run.

**Dependent claims (3)** — same illustrative exercise as claim 1, and subject to the same caveat above. NOT charted, NOT grounded, and deliberately absent from the claims-only file (#311).

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the threshold weight defaults to forty when the configuration file names no threshold.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the report is written in JSON.
4. The method of claim 1, wherein the catalog is read from a compressed archive.

_Shape vs litigated: 60 words (146, band 85-257) · 5 rows (6, band 4-11) · mechanism 3 / generic 1 (4, band 2-7) · 3 dependent(s), 3 MODIFICATION (7, band 2-17) — distance 0.40._

- `fixture.zip!proj/src/widgets/filter.js@discardHeavy` — L30-48 — discarding each widget whose weight exceeds a threshold weight
